_doc: Mode preset for lab rooms (Movement Lab online, Range Lab; PLAN §4 data/modes/). Phase 3 only needs the damage rules; round settings join when match modes arrive (Phase 6). Field names follow research/core_mechanics.md §11's recommendation. Siege's Action Phase has team damage on and Prep Phase off (§11). Reverse friendly fire is implemented but off here, so two-browser tests don't trip it; `lastAliveDies` is off because a lab has no rounds. `dummyRespawnS` is our lab setting, not a Siege value. `reinforcements` is Siege's standard defender pool (10, research/destruction.md §6); `defenderToolsForAll` lets either side reinforce and barricade in a lab (Siege: defenders only).
